output.title: New optional Vault issuer server-name setting
output.content: The change adds a configuration option to the Vault issuer for specifying the server name used when validating the Vault server's certificate. It is an added option, not a changed default. The environment summary shows no Issuer resources, no Vault-related values keys and only cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and apps/v1 Deployment manifests, so nothing shown uses it.
